INDX.name: Index
INDX.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas RACE record (wbHeadParts / wbBodyParts). Meaning depends on position: after NAM0 it is a head part (wbHeadPartIndexEnum: 0 Head, 1 Ears, 2 Mouth, 3 Teeth Lower, 4 Teeth Upper, 5 Tongue, 6 Left Eye, 7 Right Eye), after NAM1 a body part (wbDefinitionsCommon.pas wbBodyPartIndexEnum, non-TES4 branch: 0 Upper Body, 1 Left Hand, 2 Right Hand, 3 Upper Body Texture); schema v1 cannot express position-dependent enums, so it stays a plain u32

Meaning: the reputation's scale, the maximum fame or infamy [documented: GECK wiki GetReputationPct divides by the reputation's maximum value, its scale; observed: 10 to 100 in FalloutNV.esm, e.g. RepNVGoodsprings 15, RepNVCaesarsLegion 100]

DATA.name: Data
DATA.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas MGEF record (field order and archetype values from wbArchtypeEnum in wbDefinitionsCommon.pas); associated_item is a union chosen by the archetype: 1 Script (SCPT), 18 Bound Item, 19 Summon Creature (wbMGEFFAssocItemDecider); base cost, magic school and the two constant-effect factors are unused in this game [documented]. Observed: 72 bytes; PoisonRemovalEffect (archetype 1) names the effect script SCPT 0x0016198D
